avoid_supplements.name: Vitamin K (High-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin K antagonizes anticoagulant effect through hepatic clotting factor synthesis
avoid_supplements.action: Maintain consistent dietary vitamin K intake; avoid supplements >90 mcg/day without provider consultation

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inducer reduces rivaroxaban bioavailability and anticoagulant effect
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks prior to rivaroxaban initiation or avoid combination

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Platelet aggregation inhibition and possible P-glycoprotein interaction increases bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on alternative cognitive supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (Concentrated/Supplement)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects and CYP3A4 modulation increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid garlic supplements; dietary garlic in normal amounts acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Cranberry Supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Possible P-glycoprotein inhibition and warfarin-like anticoagulant activity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concentrated cranberry supplements; discuss with provider before use

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (High-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects may have additive bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding signs; use doses ≤2g/day; inform provider of supplementation

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects and potential CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use culinary doses; monitor for excessive bruising or bleeding

caution_supplements.name: Ginger Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet and possible CYP3A4 modulation effects
caution_supplements.action: Limit to culinary amounts or low-dose supplements; monitor bleeding risk

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibitor increases rivaroxaban plasma concentrations and bleeding risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice entirely; select alternative citrus beverages

caution_foods.name: High-Vitamin K Foods (Kale, Spinach, Broccoli)
caution_foods.mechanism: High vitamin K intake may antagonize anticoagulant effect if consumption dramatically changes
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake of green leafy vegetables; avoid sudden dietary changes

caution_foods.name: Cranberry Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential additive anticoagulant and P-glycoprotein inhibition effects
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation (≤12 oz/day); monitor for signs of bleeding

monitoring_notes: Rivaroxaban is a substrate of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein; interactions that inhibit these pathways increase bleeding risk while inducers reduce efficacy. Monitor for signs of bleeding (unusual bruising, blood in urine/stool, nosebleeds) and maintain consistent dietary patterns, especially regarding vitamin K and grapefruit products.
